content.text:
I fixed two layout problems on the products page, both in `site/css/components.css`. The functional tests pass (16 of 16). I also checked a screenshot of the page after the change.

- **Clipped badges:** the "New" and "Sale" badges were half cut off. They sat 10px outside the card, and the card hides anything that overflows. They now sit inside the top-right corner of the card image.
- **Misaligned prices and buttons:** cards with longer text pushed their price and "Add to cart" row lower than their neighbours. The cards now stretch to equal height with that row pinned to the bottom, so each row lines up. The bundle cards use the same styles and still look right.

The repo has only one commit, so I couldn't diff against a "last change". I found these by looking at the page itself. If something else looked wrong to you, such as the mobile layout, tell me and I'll look at that too.

STATUS: DONE
